name: seo-engine-monorepo
description: Open-source @gmbranker SEO engine — framework-agnostic SEO for JavaScript apps

scripts.build: npm run build -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-core && npm run build -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-next && npm run build -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-nuxt && npm run build -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-astro && npm run build -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-core && npm run test -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-next && npm run test -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-nuxt && npm run test -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-astro && npm run test -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-cli
scripts.check:publish: npm run build && npm test && npm pack --dry-run -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-core && npm pack --dry-run -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-next && npm pack --dry-run -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-nuxt && npm pack --dry-run -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-adapters-astro && npm pack --dry-run -w @gmbranker/seo-engine-cli
